question.name: CSEC Phy Jan 2023 Q6d(i) — Polonium-210 Alpha Decay
question.text:
A polonium-210 nucleus decays by α-particle emission to form a lead (Pb) nucleus.

Complete the nuclear equation for the decay:

\({}^{210}_{84}\text{Po} \rightarrow {}^{A}_{Z}\text{Pb} + {}^{4}_{2}\alpha\)

Determine the values of A (mass number) and Z (atomic number) of the lead nucleus produced.
question.general_feedback:
Model solution:
Conservation of mass number: A = 210 − 4 = 206
Conservation of atomic number: Z = 84 − 2 = 82
The product is \({}^{206}_{82}\text{Pb}\) (lead-206).

Check: mass numbers balance (210 = 206 + 4) ✓   atomic numbers balance (84 = 82 + 2) ✓

steps.label:
Nuclear decay rules:
Mass number (A) is conserved: Aparent = Adaughter + Aparticle
Atomic number (Z) is conserved: Zparent = Zdaughter + Zparticle
Alpha particle: \({}^{4}_{2}\alpha\) (mass number 4, atomic number 2)
Find the mass number A and atomic number Z of the lead nucleus. (3 marks)

fields.label: Mass number A = _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: A = 210 − 4 = 206 (mass number of Po minus mass number of alpha)

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Mass number conservation: A(Po) = A(Pb) + A(alpha). So A(Pb) = 210 − 4 = 206.

fields.label: Atomic number Z = _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Z = 84 − 2 = 82 (atomic number of Po minus atomic number of alpha)

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Atomic number conservation: Z(Po) = Z(Pb) + Z(alpha). So Z(Pb) = 84 − 2 = 82.

fields.label: Name of element (from periodic table): _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Atomic number 82 = Lead (Pb). Check your periodic table.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Use your periodic table: Z = 82 corresponds to Lead (Pb).
